description: Returns recent real news stories from SpeakBase Times rewritten in simple English at the learner's level (four levels, A1 to B2), with the story text, its key words and their meanings, a link to read it with exercises on SpeakBase and a link to talk about the story with Kate. English only. No sign-in.

article.description: The article id from an earlier result, to get that story's text at the chosen level.

category.description: A news category to prefer, for example Science, Technology, Sports, Health, World.

level.description: The learner's CEFR level. A1, A2 and B1 map to reading levels 1 to 3; B2 and above to level 4. Default A2.

native_language.description: The learner's own language as a two-letter code (for example he, es, ar). Used for explanations and for the language of the SpeakBase page the links open in.

name: news_in_levels
title: News in levels (SpeakBase Times)
